control_plane: GKE 1.35.8-gke.1225000, two replicas, Postgres 16 in cluster
notes: Bench nodes are n2d (AMD) because n2 was out of capacity in every us-west1 zone.
The N2D quota allowed four bench nodes: three tuned and one default.
The GPU node ran in us-central1-a because no GPU was free in us-west1; it was deleted after its study.
The studies ran over several commits while the fleet was being fixed; git_commit is the commit that published them, and each run records the revision of the binary it measured in its spec.
